# `candid prep`

Build an interview prep pack.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid prep [-h] --company COMPANY --role ROLE [--jd JD] [--location LOCATION] [--app-id APP_ID]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--company` `COMPANY` | (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | (required) |
| `--jd` `JD` | JD text, file path, URL, or - to read the JD from stdin (e.g. `cat jd.txt | python -m candid match --jd -`) |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | - |
| `--app-id` `APP_ID` | Tracker id to link the pack to |
